Name: Phalti, Son of Laish
Summary: Phalti, son of Laish of Gallim, was given Michal as wife after Saul took her from David. When David demanded her back, Phalti followed weeping behind her until Abner sent him home.
KeyStory: Palti wept as he followed Michal back to David, a husband caught in a king's bargain.
LifeLesson: Even a weeping walk home is part of the record; God notices the collateral damage of power.
